newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo gains on positive results comment.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo gains on positive results comment.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc rose in pre-market trade on Friday, extending Thursday's gains amid positive press comment on the drug company's results statement.
The stock was up 12-1/2p at 10.61-1/2 by 0808 GMT, after on Thursday rising 14p.

The Financial Times Lex column said Glaxo's optimism on sales prospects from 1999 onwards was "heartening," pointed out that its shares were on a 20-30 percent discount to peers and said drug stocks tended to outperform one a major patent problem had passed.

Glaxo shares initially dropped on Thursday after the company warned of two years of flat profits, but bounced later in the session as the market gave a largely positive reception to the company's post-results briefing with analysts.
